recipes.name: Apple and cinnamon crumble
recipes.method_note: Oats in the topping make it crunchier. Serve with custard, cream or ice cream.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Peel and core {{ing:apple-medium}}. Slice into a baking dish.
Sprinkle over {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and a third of {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}.
Rub {{ing:butter-block}} into {{ing:flour-plain}} with your fingertips, until like breadcrumbs.
Stir in {{ing:oats-rolled}} and the rest of the sugar.
Scatter the crumble over the apples. Do not press down.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden and bubbling at the edges.

recipes.name: Sticky toffee pudding
recipes.method_note: Soaking the dates is what makes it sticky. Do not skip it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Butter a baking dish about 20 by 30 cm.
Chop {{ing:dates-pitted}}. Cover with 250 ml boiling water and {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}.
Leave 10 minutes, until soft. Mash with a fork.
Beat 50 g of the butter with 100 g of the sugar until pale.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}, one at a time.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, then the dates and their water.
Pour into the dish. Bake 30 minutes, until springy in the middle.
Melt the rest of the butter and sugar in a pan.
Add {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:golden-syrup}}. Bubble 3 minutes, until glossy.
Pour half the sauce over the hot sponge. Serve with the rest.

recipes.name: Lemon posset
recipes.method_note: Three ingredients. The lemon sets the cream on its own.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a pan on a medium heat.
Bring to the boil. Bubble 3 minutes, stirring, without letting it rise over.
Take off the heat. Stir in the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Leave 5 minutes. Pour into six small glasses or cups.
Chill at least 3 hours, until set.
Top with {{ing:raspberries}} to serve.

recipes.name: Raspberry and yoghurt fool
recipes.method_note: Lighter than cream alone. Frozen raspberries work once thawed.

steps.instruction: Crush two thirds of {{ing:raspberries}} with a fork.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} until it holds soft peaks (droops at the tip).
Fold in {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}, {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Ripple the crushed raspberries through. Do not fully mix.
Spoon into four glasses. Top with the whole raspberries.

recipes.name: Bread and butter pudding
recipes.method_note: A good use for bread that is a day or two old.

steps.instruction: Butter {{ing:bread-slice-medium}} with {{ing:butter-block}}. Cut into triangles.
Layer in a baking dish with {{ing:raisins}} between the layers.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Pour over the bread. Leave 20 minutes to soak.
Heat the oven to 180C while it soaks.
Sprinkle with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}. Bake 35 minutes, until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Creamy baked rice pudding
recipes.method_note: Slow in the oven. The skin on top is the best bit for some people.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C.
Put {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a buttered baking dish.
Pour in {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Stir.
Dot with {{ing:butter-block}}. Sprinkle with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Bake 2 hours, until thick and creamy.
steps.note: Stir once after 30 minutes if you want less skin.

recipes.name: Baked apples with oats and maple
recipes.method_note: Cooking apples go fluffy; eating apples hold their shape. Both are good.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C.
Core {{ing:apple-medium}}. Score a line round the middle of each.
steps.note: The line stops the skin splitting.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:walnuts}}. Mix with {{ing:oats-rolled}}, {{ing:raisins}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Stir in {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Pack into the apples.
Stand in a dish with 3 tablespoons of water. Bake 35 minutes, until soft.

recipes.name: Chocolate mousse, dairy free
recipes.method_note: Nobody tastes the avocado. Ripe ones only: they must give when pressed.

steps.instruction: Scoop the flesh of {{ing:avocado}} into a blender.
Add {{ing:cocoa-powder}}, {{ing:maple-syrup}}, {{ing:oat-milk}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Blend 2 minutes, until completely smooth.
Spoon into four small glasses. Chill 1 hour.
Top with {{ing:raspberries}} to serve.

recipes.name: Thin pancakes with lemon and sugar
recipes.method_note: The first pancake is always a test one. Everyone knows this.

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-semi-skimmed}} until smooth.
Leave the batter 10 minutes.
Melt a little of {{ing:butter-block}} in a frying pan on a medium-high heat.
Pour in a ladleful. Tilt the pan to cover the base.
Cook 1 minute, until golden underneath. Flip. Cook 30 seconds.
Sprinkle with {{ing:sugar-caster}} and a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}. Roll up.
Repeat with the rest of the batter.

recipes.name: Pears poached in orange and cinnamon
recipes.method_note: Slightly firm pears hold their shape best.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:pear}}, leaving the stalks on.
Put {{ing:orange-juice}}, {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} in a pan that fits the pears snugly.
Stand the pears in it. Simmer (small bubbles) 20 minutes, until a knife slides in.
steps.note: Turn them now and then so they colour evenly.

steps.instruction: Lift out the pears. Boil the juice 5 minutes, until syrupy.
Serve the pears with the syrup and {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}.
steps.note: Dairy-free yoghurt keeps it dairy free.
